summary: No stronger eligible opening displaced yesterday's shortlist. Six officially live, likely-unapplied roles remain actionable, led by Sentry, Apple AiDP Reliability, and Marshall Wace. Gmail now confirms the ByteDance Seed AI Foundation Model Infrastructure submission and a Jane Street rejection. A newly surfaced GM inference role is an exceptional technical match but is not actionable for a May 2027 start because the official posting targets candidates completing by Spring/August 2026.

changes_today.role: Research Scientist Graduates (Seed AI Foundation Model Infrastructure) - 2027 Start
changes_today.reason: Gmail confirmation names the exact role and confirms the August 13 submission. This appears to consume the second Jul-Dec Early Career slot; all further ByteDance/TikTok roles remain on hold.
Gmail contains an explicit company-level rejection dated August 13. The tracker preserves role uncertainty rather than assigning the rejection to a guessed requisition.
A follow-up again requests the 20-minute AI interview; complete it within 48 hours of the original August 13 email and then notify Weekday.

changes_today.role: Machine Learning Engineer, AI Inference Solutions (Early in Career)
changes_today.reason: Technically one of the best MLSys matches found, but the official posting says candidates must complete their degree by Spring/August 2026. It is not a May 2027-start opportunity.
Official posting explicitly says Appian will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization; hard visa veto despite the $115k-$118k range.
No newly discovered public repository added enough distinct official-link signal to justify another adapter. Existing speedyapply, vanshb03, zapply and Jobright coverage remains sufficient.

recommendations.fit: Excellent infrastructure / high-volume distributed data systems
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: The official role accepts a BS or higher plus one internship and values Python, algorithms and production ownership; this matches her MSCS, TikTok internship and Python/Linux systems work.
recommendations.team_value: The Infrastructure track's Python, Rust, Kafka, ClickHouse and Kubernetes stack should value distributed-systems research, model-serving infrastructure and performance work.
recommendations.why_attractive: True 2027 new-grad scope with production infrastructure operating at terabyte-per-day scale.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact title says New Grad (2027), and both the careers listing and application link are live.
recommendations.sponsorship: Not stated on the official posting; no explicit no-sponsorship veto found. OPT/future sponsorship must be answered truthfully.
recommendations.urgency: Apply first and explicitly prefer Infrastructure Engineering.
recommendations.caveat: Team matching can also place candidates on a TypeScript/React product team; state infrastructure/backend preference clearly.

recommendations.role: Software Engineer - AiDP Reliability Engineering, IS&T, Early Career Opportunities
recommendations.salary: Not listed on the accessible official posting
recommendations.fit: Exceptional ML platform / inference / reliability overlap
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: Python plus systems, OS/networking and open-source platform experience fit the early-career qualifications; Spark/Flink/Trino/Iceberg and Kubernetes exposure are preferred rather than deep modern C++.
recommendations.team_value: Apple's Applied ML team builds ML, GenAI, inference and data platforms, making vLLM/model-loading, NCCL/multi-GPU and systems-optimization evidence directly relevant.
recommendations.why_attractive: One of the rare elite-company early-career roles explicitly centered on production ML and inference platforms.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact title says Early Career; role 200677645-0157 was posted August 12, 2026 and shows Submit Resume.
recommendations.sponsorship: Not stated; no explicit no-sponsorship language found.
recommendations.urgency: Apply promptly with ML-platform/reliability bullets prioritized.
recommendations.caveat: A different Apple Siri requisition is already active; submit only this highly differentiated role and avoid broad Apple spraying.
recommendations.application_limit: No published cap found; keep this as the single additional targeted Apple application.

recommendations.fit: Strong broad software/infrastructure plus quant-industry upside
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: The graduate program is designed for 2027 entrants and rewards algorithms, software engineering and infrastructure breadth rather than prior finance experience.
recommendations.team_value: Rotations across up to six technology teams can use her distributed-systems, Python/Linux and competitive-programming strengths.
recommendations.why_attractive: High-pay structured graduate training inside a quantitative investment firm, with multiple chances to land on systems/infrastructure work.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact 2027 graduate posting is live; start date is September 6, 2027.
recommendations.sponsorship: The application asks about authorization/sponsorship, but the posting does not promise sponsorship or state a no-sponsorship veto.
recommendations.urgency: Apply after Sentry and Apple if willing to accept broader rotations.
recommendations.caveat: Less directly ML-systems-specific, and future sponsorship remains unknown.
recommendations.application_limit: Marshall Wace instructs candidates to apply to only one role/location; choose New York and do not submit duplicates.

recommendations.fit: Strong Python/PyTorch and distributed model-training overlap; weaker visual-generation evidence
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: Recent BS/MS graduates qualify, and the official role values Python, PyTorch, distributed compute, GPU optimization and ML infrastructure.
recommendations.team_value: Her training/inference systems and multi-GPU optimization work could contribute to scaling and deployment.
recommendations.why_attractive: Frontier generative-video work with hands-on model performance and infrastructure.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact New Grad requisition is live and accepting applications.
recommendations.sponsorship: E-Verify is stated; visa sponsorship is not stated.
recommendations.urgency: Apply after the top three if she can show a credible generative-model project.
recommendations.caveat: Two years of ML and meaningful generative-model/CV work are expected; do not overstate diffusion experience. Four to five days onsite.

recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: Engineer I accepts internships, school projects or roughly one year of experience; Linux, reliability and distributed systems align.
recommendations.team_value: Her performance and distributed-systems work maps to storage reliability and AI-cloud infrastructure.
recommendations.why_attractive: Core systems work at an AI-compute company rather than product frontend.
recommendations.new_grad: Official full-time Engineer I role is live, but is not explicitly labeled 2027/new grad.
recommendations.urgency: Secondary; verify Crusoe allows multiple active applications first.
recommendations.caveat: A different Crusoe Engineer I/DCIE requisition is already active, creating duplicate-company risk.
recommendations.application_limit: Apply only if multiple active Crusoe requisitions are permitted.

recommendations.fit: Relevant ML runtime/performance work but heavily modern-C++/CUDA-oriented
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: NCCL, parallel systems and performance work are relevant, but deep recent modern-C++ and kernel expertise are not her leading strengths.
recommendations.team_value: Multi-GPU communication and inference/training systems evidence may still transfer at the software/hardware boundary.
recommendations.why_attractive: High-impact AI systems performance work that is software, not pure hardware.
recommendations.new_grad: Official University requisition explicitly says New Grad and remains live.
recommendations.urgency: Low-priority stretch after better mutual-fit roles.
recommendations.caveat: Do not lead with old contest C++; choose a US placement because OPT does not authorize Canadian employment.
